scope: Independent static review of renderer and tests only; no raw native trace was opened and no renderer/test was run by this reviewer.

validation_receipt.reported_cli_replay: PASS, byte-identical receipt plus all 8 PNG hashes

verified_properties: All input validation runs before the renderer creates its output parent or temporary staging directory.
An existing output path, including a dangling symlink, is refused before any output operation.
All score, selected-point, OLD/FIX pair-summary, component CSV, analysis receipt, and component receipt bindings are validated before rendering.
The component receipt must bind the exact analysis-receipt SHA, output CSV SHA, and byte count; the analysis receipt must bind the exact pair_summary path/SHA/bytes and pass status.
The selected_points.csv SHA and size must match the original cohort receipt.
Figures and render_receipt.json are generated inside a fresh same-parent staging directory, then published with one directory replace only after rendering completes; exceptions remove staging.
The render receipt records hashes and sizes for all source inputs and eight PNGs; the recorded eight-PNG CLI replay is byte-identical.
Renderer reads score/cohort/component products only and performs no scoring or native history access.
test_coverage_note: The three focused tests cover an existing-output sentinel, a mismatched component-output hash before target creation, and a failed paired-analysis receipt before target creation. The focused suite does not itself exercise a successful render or a mismatched run_receipt_sha256; the package validation receipt records the successful byte-identical CLI replay and code checks those bindings directly.
